claims.claim: Donald Trump said Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel, another 500,000 tons in November, and 1,000,000 tons thereafter.
claims.episode_span: Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 tons of diesel
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace, another 500,000 Tons during the month of November, and 1,000,000 Tons immediately thereafter.

claims.claim: The US Treasury said OFAC is issuing a temporary general license to allow Russian diesel onto the global market.
claims.episode_span: issuing a temporary general license for Russian diesel
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: the Office of Foreign Assets Control is immediately issuing a temporary general license to allow the supply of Russian diesel to the global market

claims.claim: US diesel reached a record $6.52 per gallon last month, more than double a year earlier.
claims.episode_span: US diesel reached a record $6.52 a gallon last month
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: The cost of diesel in the US reached a record $6.52 per gallon last month, more than double the cost a year ago.

claims.claim: Volodymyr Zelensky called the diesel decision not honest, unworthy of partners, and a weak decision, and likened it to a birthday present for Putin.
claims.episode_span: not honest, is unworthy of partners, and is a weak decision
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: It is certainly not honest, it is certainly unworthy of our partners, and it is, in my view, a weak decision.

claims.claim: The UK government said it will maintain its toughest sanctions regime and military and financial support for Ukraine while supporting US-led peace efforts.
claims.episode_span: keep military and financial support for Ukraine and the toughest sanctions regime
claims.source_title: UK government response to agreement between US and Russia: 9 October
claims.supporting_quote: We will continue working closely with international partners to ensure Ukraine has the military and financial support it needs to defend itself.

claims.claim: Steve Witkoff said Friday's Miami meeting included the E3, the European Commission, Ukraine and NATO and discussed ending the war ahead of winter.
claims.episode_span: Friday's Miami meeting with the E3
claims.source_title: US hosts ‘productive’ trilateral talks to end Russia-Ukraine war
claims.supporting_quote: Witkoff said on Friday that “constructive discussions” tackled “potential avenues to de-escalate and conclude the war with Russia ahead of winter and advance efforts toward a durable and lasting peace”.

claims.claim: Marco Rubio warned that a stalemate could end through escalation that spreads to neighbouring NATO countries.
claims.episode_span: a stalemate can end in escalation that reaches neighbouring NATO states
claims.source_title: US hosts ‘productive’ trilateral talks to end Russia-Ukraine war
claims.supporting_quote: “The other way that stalemates end is through escalation,” Rubio told reporters, warning that the conflict could spread to neighbouring NATO countries.

claims.claim: Hours after the diesel deal, a Ukrainian drone hit a Russian fuel site, and the deal was criticised by US lawmakers, Zelensky and European allies.
claims.episode_span: hours later a Ukrainian drone hit a Russian fuel site
claims.source_title: US hosts ‘productive’ trilateral talks to end Russia-Ukraine war
claims.supporting_quote: The deal was criticised by US lawmakers, Zelenskyy and European allies.

claims.claim: EA WorldView reported a fire at the Yug Rusi terminal in Rostov-on-Don and four civilians killed and four injured in a Saturday strike in Zaporizhzhia.
claims.episode_span: four civilians killed and four injured in a Saturday strike
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: Four civilians were murdered and four injured by a Russian strike on a five-story residential building in Zaporizhzhia city on Saturday.

claims.claim: A European diplomat said the war will last longer than thought, and Euronews said the €90 billion loan was designed on the premise the war would end this year.
claims.episode_span: the €90 billion loan leaders agreed last year
claims.source_title: As Russia escalates, EU realises its Ukraine support won't be enough
claims.supporting_quote: The loan, it must be noted, was designed under the premise that the war would end sometime this year.

claims.claim: Ursula von der Leyen called the strikes war crimes, and Zelensky called them terror against people and life.
claims.episode_span: Ursula von der Leyen called them war crimes
claims.source_title: As Russia escalates, EU realises its Ukraine support won't be enough
claims.supporting_quote: "Pure and simple: these are war crimes," European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said, expressing her solidarity.

claims.claim: Scotland will help draft a UK War Book as military leaders warn of large-scale conflict by 2030, the first time the Scottish Government is involved.
claims.episode_span: Scotland is to draft a new War Book with the UK
claims.source_title: Scotland to develop 'War Book' with UK as military chiefs warn of conflict by 2030
claims.supporting_quote: Scotland is to develop a new 'War Book' with the UK as military leaders warn of growing threat of a large-scale conflict by 2030.

claims.claim: A European Commission draft says Ukraine continued funding the telethon Yedyni Novyny in 2026 despite a decline in trust and reach, with presentation scheduled for late October.
claims.episode_span: kept funding the national telethon Yedyni Novyny in 2026
claims.source_title: European Commission has raised concerns with Ukraine regarding continued funding of telethon – draft report
claims.supporting_quote: Brussels notes that in 2026, state funding for the national telethon ‘Yedyni Novyny’ continued, ‘despite a decline in trust and reach’.

claims.claim: DCMS is not committed to funding the UK Youth Parliament beyond March 2027.
claims.episode_span: not committed to funding the UK Youth Parliament
claims.source_title: Teenagers urge government not to scrap UK Youth Parliament
claims.supporting_quote: The Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS) is not committed to funding the parliament beyond March 2027, leading to speculation it could close.

claims.claim: Roger Wicker said in Kyiv on Friday he cannot envision peace requiring Ukraine to cede sovereign territory seized by Russia.
claims.episode_span: cannot envision peace that requires Ukraine to give up sovereign territory
claims.source_title: Peace Cannot Come at Cost of Ukrainian Land, Senator Wicker Says
claims.supporting_quote: US Senator Roger Wicker, chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee, said on Friday, Oct. 9, that he cannot envision an end to the war in Ukraine that involves Kyiv ceding sovereign territory seized by Russia.

claims.claim: Ninety-four people from the United States sought protection in Ireland last year, up from 22 the year before.
claims.episode_span: 94 people from the United States sought protection in Ireland last year
claims.source_title: School shootings and transgender rights causing US citizens to seek asylum in Ireland
claims.supporting_quote: Ninety-four people from United States sought protection here last year, up from 22 the year before

claims.claim: Donald Trump criticised Norway after the Nobel Peace Prize went to Navanethem Pillay, calling the decision an indelible stain on Norway.
claims.source_title: A shameful and unfortunate decision — Trump criticized Norway over the Nobel Peace Prize
claims.supporting_quote: This is an indelible stain on the country of Norway and on the people who made such a shameful and regrettable decision," Trump said.
